title: Etika, sigurnosni koncepti i governance
summary: ISC2 Code of Professional Ethics (preambula i četiri kanona po prioritetu), etika u AI (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) i organizacioni kodeks, pet svojstava (CIA, authenticity, non-repudiation) i DAD, governance usklađen sa poslovanjem, akvizicije i divesticije, uloge (owner, custodian, uprava), okviri ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0 i 800-53, COBIT, SABSA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP te due care i due diligence.
summary_en: ISC2 Code of Professional Ethics (preamble and the four canons in order of priority), ethics in AI (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and the organizational code of ethics, the five properties (CIA, authenticity, non-repudiation) and DAD, governance aligned with the business, acquisitions and divestitures, roles (owner, custodian, senior management), the ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0 and 800-53, COBIT, SABSA, PCI DSS and FedRAMP frameworks, and due care and due diligence.
